rule: Default post-PR watch is a fixed-default read biased to watching
description: P3 coupling. The post-PR watch is opt-out only, and what contains it is a BIAS, not determinism: one fixed default (`watch_requested`) and one admissible escape (`not_requested`), reachable only through an explicit no-watch instruction in the user's original request. The source pin sits on ONE span carrying BOTH halves of that conditional: the discriminating condition (`not_requested` holds if and only if the original request carries an explicit instruction not to watch or monitor the PR) and the obligation it triggers (every other case, including silence and ambiguity, yields `watch_requested`). Either half alone is rewritable while the other stays green -- deleting the `if and only if` keying re-opens the outcome to discretion, and inverting the default clause flips silence back to not-watching -- so both live inside the pinned span. Three further claim-carrying mechanisms in the same canonical file are pinned as separate entries, because the default rests on each of them: (a) the citation obligation, pinned as one span covering its trigger (taking `not_requested`), its destination (the state-result's free-form `event.outputs`), the key name `watch_optout_citation`, and the fallback to `watch_requested` when no span can be cited -- any one of those four rewritten alone would hollow the obligation out, so they are pinned together; (b) the `HIVEMIND_SKIP_PR_WATCH` operator short-circuit, pinned as four short spans -- the named key, its presence-only test, its precedence over the `request.raw` read, and the unset-or-empty complement that preserves the default -- so neither the escape nor its complement can be rewritten while the other stays green; (c) the Reflex site's POINTER, pinned in POINTER shape per rule 3 of the pin-authoring contract: the Reflex tail names the canonical `## Review Remediation Posture` predicate instead of restating it, and the do-not-restate sentence is pinned beside it, so severing the second site from the canonical rule is loud. The workflow consumer is likewise pinned by POINTER, not by remedy prose: `plugin/workflows/standard-delivery.json` must keep naming the overlord agent rule as the source of truth for the `github_review_decision` description, so severing the workflow description from its canonical rule is loud while honest rewording of the surrounding description is not. What this fixture honestly guarantees is exactly that these word sequences exist in these two named files; it claims nothing about meaning and nothing about runtime behavior. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) the predicate is a NATURAL-LANGUAGE READ of untrusted prose, so no pin here can evaluate whether a given request is classified correctly -- the real containment is the bias toward `watch_requested`, and that bias protects against a hedging or uncertain read, which the ambiguity clause routes to watching, but NOT against a CONFIDENT LITERAL MISREAD, which can still reach `not_requested`; (2) the citation obligation is pinned as TEXT only -- a presence pin proves the obligation is still written down, never that the overlord actually records `watch_optout_citation` into `event.outputs` at runtime; (3) a meaning-preserving rewrite-around is invisible -- surrounding prose that re-introduces overlord discretion while leaving the pinned bytes intact stays green; (4) the Reflex entries keep the pointer and the do-not-restate instruction present, but a presence pin cannot assert body-prose ABSENCE, so a second copy of the predicate growing back at that site, or at any site, is undetectable here; (5) no fixture in this directory can detect a NEW workflow state, or a new decision state in another workflow, that fails to carry the rule at all -- that is an absence defect per rule 7 of the pin-authoring contract and needs a structural check, not a presence pin.

source.pattern: The outcome is `not_requested` if and only if the user's original request carries an explicit instruction not to watch or monitor the PR; in every other case, including silence and ambiguity, the outcome is `watch_requested`.

consumers.pattern: This rule is stated normatively in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/agents/overlord.md (the opt-out-only GitHub review watch default rule) — that agent rule is the source of truth and this description must stay in lockstep with it.

Taking `not_requested` therefore OBLIGES the overlord to record, into the `github_review_decision` state-result's free-form `event.outputs`, the VERBATIM `request.raw` substring it relied on, under the key `watch_optout_citation`; when no such span can be cited, the outcome is `watch_requested`.
A standing operator preference short-circuits the read entirely: `HIVEMIND_SKIP_PR_WATCH`
Check it by PRESENCE with a simple non-empty test
TAKES PRECEDENCE over the `request.raw` read and short-circuits it
Unset or empty means the `request.raw` read above applies unchanged
under the canonical predicate stated once under `## Review Remediation Posture` (Default post-PR watch)
The predicate itself is NOT restated here, so the two sites cannot drift.
